_comment: Where this site actually lives. Everything that has to name a host —
the canonical link, the social cards, the JSON-LD, robots.txt and
sitemap.xml — is generated from siteUrl by tools/build-www.js.
Leave siteUrl empty until you control the address. A canonical URL
pointing at a host you do not own tells Google that the real version
of the page is over there, and it will rank that instead of yours.
With this empty the build simply writes no canonical, which is
correct: no canonical is far better than a wrong one.
Set it to whatever you publish on, with no trailing slash, e.g.
name: Heavyline Logistics
description: The digital headquarters of the HLL fleet. Convoys, dispatch, live fleet tracking, driver rankings and achievements, in one command centre.
tagline: A virtual trucking company running convoys, dispatch and a live fleet across Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
